name: juried
description: A design studio with a jury: one sentence in, a researched website out that is structurally new every time. It searches Awwwards, Site of Sites, recent.design and Dribbble live on each build, borrows a different part of the design from each reference, and is graded by a calibrated vision jury, with gates that fail re-skins and clones, until it scores 7+/10.
